episodes.title: Everything Is Priority One
episodes.lesson: Choose what comes first and say what can wait.
episodes.ask_your_team: What can wait so the first job can finish?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for choosing what comes first
episodes.kudos_quote: Dry socks. Priority one.

episodes.title: Just One Tiny Change
episodes.lesson: Before adding another change, agree what it costs and what can wait.
episodes.ask_your_team: Which changes improve the outcome, and which delay useful delivery?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for asking what can wait
episodes.kudos_quote: What can we leave for later?

episodes.title: We Needed It Yesterday
episodes.lesson: Test the work under real working conditions, even when time is short.
episodes.ask_your_team: Which real conditions could invalidate our test?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for testing it for real
episodes.kudos_quote: Now try it with the books.

episodes.title: Another Alignment Call
episodes.lesson: When the decision is already made, share it instead of scheduling another meeting.
episodes.ask_your_team: Which meeting could become a clear message?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for saving us a meeting
episodes.kudos_quote: Then send one group message.

episodes.title: Waiting for Approval
episodes.lesson: Find who can approve, then agree a follow-up time and next step.
episodes.ask_your_team: Who can approve our blocked work, and when will we follow up?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for getting us unblocked
episodes.kudos_quote: Finally! The books have a home.

episodes.title: One Moment!
episodes.lesson: Leave some capacity free so unexpected work does not have to wait.
episodes.ask_your_team: Where are we planning every minute, and what capacity could we leave free?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for leaving room to help
episodes.kudos_quote: Let’s keep Amr free in case someone needs help.

episodes.title: Nobody Owns It
episodes.lesson: Own the outcome; you do not have to do every part yourself.
episodes.ask_your_team: Which job lacks a clear owner, and who will see it through?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for seeing it through
episodes.kudos_quote: I’ll own this job until it’s fixed.

episodes.title: All Clear!
episodes.lesson: Do not call your part finished if it leaves someone else stuck.
episodes.ask_your_team: When we call our part done, whose work could it leave stuck?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for not leaving anyone stuck
episodes.kudos_quote: All clear! No climbing required.

episodes.title: 47 Features. Still Thirsty.
episodes.lesson: Check whether your work helped the person who needed it.
episodes.ask_your_team: What are we counting, and how would we know it actually helped the person who needed it?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for checking it really helped
episodes.kudos_quote: Ah! That’s what I needed.

episodes.title: Our Biggest Queue Yet!
episodes.lesson: Choose a measure that tells you when and how to act.
episodes.ask_your_team: Which measure would trigger a useful action?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for a measure we can act on
episodes.kudos_quote: Six waiting: I open counter two!

episodes.title: One Size Fits... Who?
episodes.lesson: Let people with different needs try an idea before you commit to it.
episodes.ask_your_team: Which idea are we about to choose, and who should try it first?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for letting us try it first
episodes.kudos_quote: Can we try it first?

episodes.title: But You Were Closed!
episodes.lesson: Before speaking for everyone, check whose voices you have not heard.
episodes.ask_your_team: Who is missing from our feedback, and how will we reach them?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for hearing every voice
episodes.kudos_quote: Who did you ask?

episodes.title: The Pass That Wouldn’t Let Him Pass
episodes.lesson: Make “the person can use it” part of your definition of done.
episodes.ask_your_team: For our current work, what must the person be able to do before we call it complete?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for checking I could really use it
episodes.kudos_quote: Made it! We can start.

episodes.title: Just for Today
episodes.lesson: A temporary fix can help today; delaying the repair can create more work every day.
episodes.ask_your_team: Which small repair are we repeatedly postponing?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for fixing it properly
episodes.kudos_quote: Dry!

episodes.title: Not Quite Ready
episodes.lesson: Let a real user try the draft while their feedback can still change it.
episodes.ask_your_team: Whose feedback could improve the draft today?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for sharing the draft early
episodes.kudos_quote: Tomorrow, ten to twelve. Got it.

episodes.title: Can We Skip the Test?
episodes.lesson: Cut the extras before you cut a critical check.
episodes.ask_your_team: Which check is essential, and what optional extra can wait?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for keeping the check that matters
episodes.kudos_quote: Music can wait. Let’s check the mic.

episodes.title: The Remote Rescue
episodes.lesson: Restore the service first. Then change what keeps causing the same problem.
episodes.ask_your_team: Which problem keeps coming back, and what keeps causing it?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for fixing the cause
episodes.kudos_quote: Then let’s give it a home.

episodes.title: Who Caused This?
episodes.lesson: Own your part in the mistake, then change the process that let it reach the customer.
episodes.ask_your_team: What is our part, and what process change would help next time?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for owning your part
episodes.kudos_quote: Copying ten was my mistake.

episodes.title: We’ll Fix It Next Meeting
episodes.lesson: Choose one improvement, make a specific commitment, and follow through.
episodes.ask_your_team: Which improvement have we agreed more than once without doing it, and what stopped us?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for keeping your promise
episodes.kudos_quote: That can wait. We’re done.

episodes.title: Where Did the Data Go?
episodes.lesson: When a request goes missing, trace its route and fix the handoff.
episodes.ask_your_team: Where could a request get lost between channels?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for tracing where it got lost
episodes.kudos_quote: Which requests feed this report?

episodes.title: Still Relevant?
episodes.lesson: Before dismissing an old request, check whether the need still exists.
episodes.ask_your_team: Which old request are we about to drop, and how will we check whether the need still exists?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for checking the need is still real
episodes.kudos_quote: The team still needs this every day.

episodes.title: But We Agreed!
episodes.lesson: Before rejecting a change, ask why it is needed.
episodes.ask_your_team: Which change are we resisting, and have we asked why it is needed?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for asking why
episodes.kudos_quote: Phone or paper. Same guest list.

episodes.title: Just Add More People
episodes.lesson: Give new helpers clear responsibilities and the authority to act.
episodes.ask_your_team: Which decisions can helpers make themselves?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for trusting us to decide
episodes.kudos_quote: No need for my approval. Bring me the tricky cases.

episodes.title: We Paid for the Whole Day
episodes.lesson: Choose the next step for its value, whatever you have already spent.
episodes.ask_your_team: What are we continuing only because we have already invested in it, and what would we choose if we started today?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for choosing what helps next
episodes.kudos_quote: Come on. We’ll be your audience.

episodes.title: Ninety Per Cent Done
episodes.lesson: When nothing is ready to use, finish one thing before starting more.
episodes.ask_your_team: What have we started but not finished, and which one could we finish first?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for finishing one first
episodes.kudos_quote: Forget four. Finish one!

episodes.title: Any Questions?
episodes.lesson: Welcome problems without making the messenger own the whole fix.
episodes.ask_your_team: What makes a problem hard to raise, and how could we make it easier?
episodes.kudos_headline: Thanks for speaking up
episodes.kudos_quote: You told me. I gave you more work. Thank you, Mouse. I’ll handle the printer.
